SUBJECT: Halden WMS migration - dry run 2 results and decision needed by Fri 18 Sep

Hi Rosa,

Dry run 2 completed over the weekend. The carrier code issue from dry run 1 is resolved and signed off.

We found a data quality issue in the legacy WMS affecting historical shipment records. Mixed date formats (dd/mm and mm/dd) were stored inconsistently until Halden standardised in Jan 2019. This affects 312k of 2.4M total records (13%), nearly all pre-2019. Records from 2019 onward are clean (99.99% pass rate).

Two options:

OPTION A: Cleanse all history before go-live
- Go-live moves to Mon 19 Oct (inside peak season start of 12 Oct)
- All 2.4M records available day one
- Change request: EUR 18,400
- 9 working days additional data work

OPTION B: Go-live 5 Oct as planned, archive cleansed after
- Go-live Mon 5 Oct (before peak)
- 2.09M records (Jan 2019 onward) available day one
- Pre-2019 records loaded read-only by Mon 30 Nov
- Old WMS stays available for pre-2019 lookups until Dec 31 per SOW
- Change request: EUR 6,200
- 9 working days data work (happens after go-live)

We recommend Option B to stay ahead of peak season. Day-to-day warehouse operations use recent records; pre-2019 is primarily for audits and can be accessed via the legacy system until the archive is ready.

Decision needed by EOD Friday 18 Sep so we can book the cutover freeze window with Stratacore (10 business day lead time required). Mira Castellanos will sign the change request per SOW section 7.2.

Rotterdam training remains on track for 29 Sep.

Happy to discuss on tomorrow's call if you're available, or by phone.

Best,
[Your name]

- **Mobile-friendly format**: Short paragraphs, clear structure, no long blocks of text
- **Dry run 2 results**: The data quality issue with pre-2019 records (312k/2.4M affected by mixed date formats)
- **Two clear options** with costs and implications, highlighting that Option B keeps you ahead of peak season (Oct 12)
- **Urgent deadline**: Friday Sept 18 EOD for the decision (due to Stratacore's 10-day lead time)
- **Key details**: Mira signs the CR (not Tomasz who's on leave), Rotterdam training date, old WMS availability for lookups

The email is concise and scannable on a phone, as Rosa requested. The recommendation for Option B aligns with her strong preference to avoid touching systems during peak season (Oct 12-Dec 20).
